reviewRulings: Source/title/role/state caption may reside in metadata; missing bitmap caption is not blocking.
A real local component/state crop is sufficient when metadata precisely maps source/owner/host. Existing host, if drawn, must preserve source capabilities.
Light raster texture and approximate geometry are implementation token guidance, not grounds for indefinite bitmap revisions.

No raster can prove API behavior, owner enforcement, keyboard/focus, accessible names, input filtering, busy guards, resizing or responsive fit.
Only the declared coherent visible state was reviewed; incompatible state variants are not asserted to coexist.
